Deck Creator Studio

Bring your ideas into a deck

Work card by card through eight guided pillars, from first spark to launch, while your guidebook takes shape as you write. Start free, and add Leilia's guidance whenever you want it.

Start free with ExploreCompare pathways

Free to start · Your work stays yours

For the work you want people to hold

Turn a creative idea, professional practice or body of knowledge into a deck. You can begin with notes or visual ideas. When you're ready for artwork, the Artist Studio connects you with artists who specialize in card design.

  • Tarot
  • Oracle
  • Educational
  • Reflective
  • Hybrid

What’s inside

Inside the Studio

Every part of the Studio is built around one aim: helping you bring your deck from first idea to a deck ready for the world.

Eight guided pillars

The Studio guides you through eight pillars, from creative concept to selling or crowdfunding your deck. You always know where you are and what comes next.

  1. 1The Spark
  2. 2The Foundation
  3. 3The Architecture
  4. 4The Expression
  5. 5The Visual World
  6. 6The Companion
  7. 7The Making
  8. 8Into the World

Included in: Explore, Create, Collaborate, Develop

Back to the comparison

An editorial workspace that's easy to use

Write and refine each card in a clear, focused editor built for deck creators. No design or publishing experience needed.

Included in: Explore (up to 10 cards); Create, Collaborate, Develop (unlimited cards)

Back to the comparison

Your guidebook builds as you write

Everything you write for your cards flows into your guidebook, with a visual preview as you go.

From Create onward, download it as a professionally formatted PDF, ideal for digital sales, with no layout headaches.

A downloadable PDF is not a commercial print file. Print-ready files need validated production specifications for your printer.

Included in: Explore (authoring and preview for 10 cards); Create, Collaborate, Develop (authoring, preview and PDF download)

Back to the comparison

Book and manage your sessions in one place

Your group sessions and private consultations all live in your member area, so they’re easy to request, check and keep track of. Leilia personally confirms each session time, so you’ll always know when you’re meeting.

Included in: Collaborate (6 group sessions, 1 consultation, 1 written review). Develop (8 group sessions, 4 consultations, 2 written reviews).

Back to the comparison

Extra editorial support when you need it

Sometimes a project needs more help than your pathway includes, and that’s completely normal. You can add human editorial support at any stage, and we’ll give you a quote based on the scope of your work, so you only pay for what you need.

Available on: Create, Collaborate, Develop

Back to the comparison

Create alongside other creators

Making a deck is easier with good company. The Studio Community is where creators share progress, swap insights, ask questions and cheer each other on.

Learn more about the Community

The Studio guides you through eight pillars of deck creation, from your first idea all the way to production and, if it suits your project, crowdfunding. The Community is organised the same way, with a focused group for each pillar. That way your questions reach people working through the same stage, and the answers stay relevant to where you are.

If you’d like Leilia’s view, just tag @Leilia in your post and she’ll add her thoughts.

Included in: Explore, Create, Collaborate, Develop

Back to the comparison

Find the artist for your deck

DCS invites artists who specialise in card design to showcase their work here, specifically for creators who are starting a deck. Browse their portfolios at your own pace, get a feel for each artist’s style, and contact anyone whose work speaks to your vision. When you find the right match, the decisions, agreements and payments are made directly between you and the artist you choose.

Included in: Create, Collaborate, Develop, Realise

Back to the comparison

See it, share it, take it with you

You can build and edit everything inside the Studio, with working previews along the way. Your work belongs to you, so you can export it whenever you like. We make leaving easy, but we hope the support you get here makes you want to stay.

Included in: Create, Collaborate, Develop

Back to the comparison

Ready to begin?

Start free with ExploreSee pathways and pricing

The person behind the Studio

Meet Leilia

Leilia has spent more than 40 years reading and interpreting cards, and 30 years as a journalist, broadcaster and editor. She built the Studio because she needed it herself: one place to bring card meanings, artwork, research and guidebook writing together. Now it's yours, with her guidance whenever you want it.

A close creative partnership

Realise

Inquiry-led

For the deck that deserves its fullest expression.

Realise is a private partnership for creators who want their deck to reach its full potential. Leilia Spencer brings more than four decades of intuitive practice, thirty years as a journalist and editor, and a career spent mentoring businesses. Together, that experience shapes every part of your project, from concept and voice to production and launch.

Your partnership also includes the support of a dedicated human executive assistant, who takes care of the details so your attention stays on the work. The full scope of support is tailored to you and agreed before any work begins. With this level of support behind it, your vision is held from start to finish, and bringing it to life feels effortless.

Realise is reserved for creators who are committed to bringing their vision to life and want the right structure around them to do it.

Each partnership starts with a private conversation, with no obligation. Propose a few times that suit you, and Leilia will confirm one personally.

Explore the partnershipBegin a private conversation

Your work stays yours

Deck Creator Studio is where you make your deck. Using it never gives us any claim to what you create.

You own what you create

Your ideas, card text, guidebook and artwork are yours, from the first sketch to the final print run. Using the Studio, its tools or its guidance never gives DCS any ownership of your work. We’re here to help you build your deck, not to claim it.

Your project stays private

Your project is visible only to you until you decide to share it. If you post in the Studio Community, that’s your choice, and your project stays separate from anything you share there.

You can read our Privacy Policy to see how we look after your personal information.

Working with artists and collaborators

Many decks are made with other people, such as artists, designers, illustrators and co-authors. The Studio offers practical guidance to help those partnerships go well. Talking early about who does what, what will be delivered and what everyone expects saves a lot of heartache later. Keep checking in about revisions, deadlines and approvals as the work moves along.

We also suggest putting ownership and permissions in writing, including licensing, credit and how the work can be used. Your agreements, payments and intellectual-property decisions are between you and the people you work with, so they remain your responsibility. Our guidance is there to support you along the way, but it isn’t a substitute for independent legal advice. If you’re unsure, a short chat with a lawyer is always worth it.

Questions first?

Most answers are in the DCS FAQ, from what’s included to how payments work.

Read the DCS FAQStart free with Explore

The Studio and your project

What is Deck Creator Studio, and who is it for?

Deck Creator Studio helps you develop an idea into a connected deck of cards and writing. It is for writers, artists, coaches, educators and other creators who want to shape their experience or creative work into something people can use.

The creative journey connects your concept, card structure, writing, guidebook and publication planning. Choose independent development or add the human guidance your project needs.

Can I create tarot, oracle and other kinds of decks?

Yes. The Studio welcomes tarot, oracle, hybrid, reflective, educational and professional-practice decks. The starting point is what you want the deck to help its reader explore or do, rather than a requirement to follow one tradition.

Do I need publishing, design or deck-creation experience?

You can begin with an idea, notes or visual material; finished artwork is not required. Create supports independent development, while Collaborate, Develop and Realise offer different levels of human guidance as you work toward a coherent deck.

Start with Explore

What can I do with the free Explore pathway?

Explore lets you begin developing your deck at no cost, with free, ongoing concept development and up to 10 active cards. It is a way to experience Deck Creator Studio before deciding whether to continue with Create or a supported pathway.

Start free with Explore

What can I achieve with the 10-card allowance?

Use a small working selection to test your concept, develop card ideas and see whether the Studio suits your way of creating. You do not need to settle the final size of your deck before you begin.

One active project and a maximum of ten active cards at any one time.

How is Explore different from Create?

Explore includes all eight pillars, the editorial interface, up to 10 cards and guidebook authoring and visual preview for those cards. Create includes unlimited cards, guidebook PDF download and working exports.

Choose Explore to begin; choose Create when you want unlimited cards and guidebook downloads.

Choose your support

What does Create cost?

Create is US$12 monthly or US$120 annually. It includes unlimited cards, the independent creation tools, guidebook PDF download and working exports. Paid consultations and written reviews are not included as standard Create benefits.

Review monthly Create or annual Create

What does Collaborate include, and what does it cost?

Collaborate is US$590 upfront or 2 payments of US$310, US$620 in total. It includes 6 group sessions, 1 private consultation and 1 written review and 12 months of Create access.

How Collaborate and Develop work

Collaborate suits creators who want group guidance and focused individual input.

What does Develop include, and what does it cost?

Develop is US$1,490 upfront or 3 payments of US$525, US$1,575 in total. It includes 8 group sessions, 4 private consultations, 2 written editorial reviews and 12 months of Create access.

How Collaborate and Develop work

Develop provides more individual attention to your concept, structure and writing.

What makes Realise different?

The partnership includes development, production and publishing planning, with crowdfunding guidance where desired. You retain project control and responsibility for external expenditure. Additional out-of-scope services are separately contracted.

Explore Realise and its private introductory conversation.

Payments and pathway terms

How Collaborate and Develop work

  • Pay once, or in fixed installments. Nothing renews automatically.
  • 12 months of Create are included.
  • Each group session and private consultation is 30 minutes.

Can I pay in installments?

Collaborate offers 2 payments of US$310, US$620 in total, instead of US$590 upfront. Develop offers 3 payments of US$525, US$1,575 in total, instead of US$1,490 upfront.

These are fixed pathway payment schedules, not cancel-anytime subscriptions. Realise payment arrangements are discussed individually; no installment schedule is stated here.

The remaining fixed payments are still due.

How Collaborate and Develop work

Do subscriptions or supported pathways renew automatically?

Create is a monthly or annual subscription that renews until canceled under its applicable terms. Collaborate and Develop are finite supported pathways and do not automatically renew.

How Collaborate and Develop work

What happens when a supported pathway ends?

How Collaborate and Develop work

Review your next access option and any additional support you need before your included Create access ends. Realise follow-on workspace arrangements are agreed separately.

Your work and publication

Will I own my deck, artwork and writing?

You retain ownership of your original creative work and control over its direction. You remain responsible for rights and permissions for any third-party artwork, photographs or text you include.

Can I export my work and publish independently?

Create includes working exports for further editing and publication planning. You can develop your own publication path; working copies are different from a printer’s finished production files.

Before choosing a production workflow, confirm the formats and specifications needed for your particular deck. Explore’s free allowance does not imply unrestricted export access.

Will my unpublished work remain private?

Your deck project and a Community contribution are separate. You choose what material to share in a discussion; a project manuscript is not itself a Community post.

The Privacy Policy explains how personal information is handled. Ownership of your creative work is a separate matter.

Who handles artwork, printing and other project costs?

You are responsible for permissions and any agreements with artists, printers or publishers. In Realise, you retain project control and contract and pay external suppliers directly; the Studio does not hold or administer project expenditure or crowdfunding funds.

Discuss any supplier or production requirements for your intended publication before committing to them.

Guidance and getting started

What kind of human guidance is available?

Collaborate includes 6 group sessions, 1 private consultation and 1 written review. Develop includes 8 group sessions, 4 private consultations and 2 written reviews. Standard sessions and consultations are 30 minutes each. A written review is focused editorial guidance, not a full-manuscript edit.

Publishing, sales and crowdfunding outcomes are not guaranteed.

Can I change pathways or obtain additional help?

Discuss the support your project now needs with Leilia. Additional editorial work can be separately scoped and quoted. Agree any pathway or payment change before proceeding; existing purchases retain their recorded terms.

How do I register and begin?

Start with Explore if you want to try the Studio before selecting a paid pathway. New creators register for an account; existing members sign in to their current account.

Start free with Explore or sign in to an existing account

Where can I ask about the right pathway before purchasing?

Email hello@tidesofknowing.com with a brief description of your deck and the kind of support you are considering. For a closer commercial partnership, begin with Realise and its private introductory conversation.

consultation.html:
Deck Creator Studio / Realise / Private consultation

A private introduction

Let's talk about your deck

You have a deck in mind. Let’s explore what it could become, where you feel stuck, and which next steps would help you move forward.

  1. 1 · Meet Leilia
  2. 2 · Your project
  3. 3 · Propose a time

Let’s find a way forward for your deck

“Perhaps your cards are taking shape, but the writing has stalled. Perhaps you can see the finished deck, but the route to publication feels uncertain. Bring your ideas and questions. We’ll talk about what matters most to your project and whether working together feels right.”

Read the partnership details

A little about you and the deck

Please give the essentials. There is no need to send a manuscript, financial records or sensitive personal material.

A sentence or two is enough. What is the deck about, and who is it for?

Suggest a time that could work

Leilia is based in Mérida. Enter the proposed date and time in her timezone; your equivalent time appears below. Availability is confirmed manually.

America/Merida · the date and time here are Leilia’s, not your device’s local time.

Check the detected city timezone or enter another, such as Europe/London. You can type it manually if automatic detection is unavailable.

Choose a date and time to compare both timezones.

Read the Privacy Policy for information about how personal details are handled. This checkbox does not sign you up for marketing emails.

Your consultation request

Review your details and contact Leilia to agree a time. Your consultation is booked only when Leilia confirms it.

Contact Leilia
